nom: TULA So Poreless Deep Exfoliating Scrub

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are mostly positive, several saying they were nervous to try a scrub but found it gentle, creamy, and non-irritating; the exception is one reviewer with reactive skin who found it so under-exfoliating that even doubling or tripling the recommended amount produced no visible change.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin saw no real change in her pores or overall skin condition, though it didn't make her skin worse either; another with sensitive, combination, acne-prone skin found it cleared up flaky skin from healed blemishes without irritation.
segments.oily: One reviewer who has managed oily skin and enlarged pores for years, including with PCOS, calls this her holy-grail product for fast, effective results.
segments.dry: One reviewer describes it as gentle yet effective on drier patches of her skin.

concerns.oiliness: Reports on pores and blackheads are mixed but lean positive: many reviewers describe visibly smaller pores or significantly fewer blackheads within one to a few weeks, while several others, including one with combination skin, say they saw no real change in their pores or blackheads despite continued use.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers managing acne-prone skin report clearer skin and noticeably fewer breakouts with regular use, in some cases alongside other products from the same line; no reviewer in this set reports new breakouts from using it.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers specifically note the scrub doesn't dry out their skin despite being an exfoliant, describing it as gentle enough for regular use without tightness or dryness afterward.

aspects.libelle: Scrub texture feels too mild for some
Can leave a residue or film on skin
A little product goes a long way

extraits.texte: I got this upon wanting to swap exfoliators and I was very excited because I had heard very good things about this brand. This product is utterly useless. My skin is reactive and so I try and stay away from overly harsh or abrasive exfoliators, but this is so under-exfoliating that it's comical. I've seen no change what-so-ever in my skin since using this and I've tried using the recommended amount and double that. I wouldn't waste your money on this, it's disappointing. You shouldn't have to use double or triple the recommended amount of a product to get sub-par results.

I've tried a few Tula products in the past and didn't really care for any of them BUT I keep going back and trying others. I purchased this scrub along with a few other items and I'm not impressed. The scrub barely has any "scrub" to it. The smell is fine. The amount of product you get for the price is pathetic. This also leaves a film on my face and my skin feels anything but clean and exfoliated. I think I have finally learned my lesson. No more Tula for me.

So i finished this today and i wanted to wait to write a review until i finished it. the scrub aspect is great if you like gritty scrubs! however, i never saw much of a difference in pores or overall skin conditions. i have combo skin and it could totally be for the fact its just not that good for my skin type. still, i think it smells nice and has the texture that i like! also, it didnt make my skin worse so i guess thats a plus!

I have pretty much always been consciously aware of my oily skin and larger pores, This is the one product that actually delivered fast and effective results. I am 48 so it is more common I think to have dry skin issues, With having PCO's however my oily skin seems to persist. I can honestly say that this and other Tula products have worked very well with my skin type, This one is my go-to favorite and I consider it my holy grail.

This product was recommended by an esthetician who was working PT at Ulta. I will always buy this product! I was having problems with breakouts and when I used it, GONE! I love the way it leaves my skin feeling and looking! Use cold water to rinse.

I have sensitive, combination, acne prone skin. I use this 2 times a week and love how it exfoliates and helps clear up flaky skin from healed blemishes. It smells nice, and doesn't irritate my skin at all. I do wish there was a little more in the container, but it doesn't take much for each use.
The exfoliating scrub was exactly what I was looking for! Gently, yet tough on my dry skin spots.
